description: Updates a check item's attributes (name, position, state) or moves it to a different checklist on the same card, requiring the card ID, current checklist ID, and check item ID.

idCard.description: The ID or short link of the card containing the checklist item.
idCard.title: Id Card

idCheckItem.description: The ID of the check item to be updated.
idCheckItem.title: Id Check Item

idChecklist.description: The ID of the target checklist to move the check item to. If omitted, the item remains in its current checklist.
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

idChecklistCurrent.description: The ID of the checklist that currently contains the check item to be updated.
idChecklistCurrent.title: Id Checklist Current

name.description: The new name for the check item. Must be a string with a length from 1 to 16384 characters.
name.title: Name

pos.description: The new position for the check item within its checklist. Accepts 'top', 'bottom', or a positive number (float or integer). Higher numbers are further down the list.
pos.title: Pos

state.description: The new completion state of the check item. Valid values are 'complete', 'incomplete', 'true', or 'false'. 'true' is an alias for 'complete', and 'false' is an alias for 'incomplete'.
state.title: State

name: update_checklist_item_by_ids

due.description: Due date for the check item in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2021-02-12T07:00:00.000Z'). Can be null.
due.title: Due

dueReminder.description: Due date reminder setting for the check item. Can be null.
dueReminder.title: Due Reminder

id.description: Unique identifier for the check item.
id.title: Id

idChecklist.description: The ID of the parent checklist containing this check item.
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

idMember.description: ID of the member assigned to the check item. Can be null if no member is assigned.
idMember.title: Id Member

name.description: The name/text of the check item.
name.title: Name

nameData.description: Additional name data for the check item. Often null.
nameData.title: Name Data

pos.description: The position of the check item in the checklist, used for ordering.
pos.title: Pos

state.description: The completion state of the check item. Possible values: 'complete' or 'incomplete'.
state.title: State
